releaseNotes: v1.37.0 — Real voice recording for Voice Journal. Voice Journal now records actual audio through the microphone and transcribes it with Gemini — no dependence on the device speech engine. Speak in English or Amharic, edit the transcript, optionally translate it, then let AI organize your own words. Failures are real and recoverable: retry transcription or translation without re-recording, and a permanent microphone block opens device settings directly. A new Voice diagnostics screen in Settings lets support pinpoint the exact cause of any issue. The flow is whisper-simple: tap the mic, speak, stop, and your words appear.
